name: 21st API
description:
REST API for the 21st.dev component marketplace: search and install components, publish components/templates/themes, and manage libraries and your account. This is the same surface the `21st` CLI and the 21st MCP server call — everything here is also reachable through those, but a direct HTTP client (or an agent building its own integration) can call it too.

Most capability is also available with lower friction through the 21st MCP server (https://21st.dev/mcp.md) or the `21st` CLI (https://21st.dev/.well-known/skills/21st-cli-use/SKILL.md) — use this spec when you need direct HTTP access instead.
